ModMetaData.name: RimLazy · Colony Work Planner
ModMetaData.author: RimLazy
ModMetaData.description:
殖民地自动分工。内置细分岗位和可调的工作优先级，默认六档。在「分工」中设置战略与培养代价，预览、应用或撤销整张工作表。赶工按当前状态选人，单次覆盖保留日常预设。
Plan specialized jobs with up to 99 priority levels. Choose colony goals and the current performance you can trade for training. Rush a shift using current working conditions. Preview, apply or undo in the Planner tab.
[AI 辅助生成]
